title: How to Solve Few-Shot Abusive Content Detection Using the Data We Actually Have

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating few-shot text classification models on their ability to detect misogyny and sexism using annotated datasets like AMI, SRW, and ToLD-Br.
Evaluating few-shot text classification models on their ability to detect racism and white supremacist content using annotated datasets like SRW, ToLD-Br, and Stormfront.
Evaluating text classification models on their ability to detect xenophobia and hate speech targeting immigrants using the HatEval and ToLD-Br datasets.
Evaluating text classification performance on identifying LGBTQ+phobic language using the fine-grained ToLD-Br dataset.

Using the HateCheck functional test suite to measure unintended algorithmic bias, specifically checking if the models incorrectly flag non-hate speech simply because it mentions protected groups or uses counter-speech.
